# Surgical: Institutional ranking
# Generated from JuliaBUGS.BUGSExamples.VOLUME_1.surgical_realistic
using JuliaBUGS

model_def = JuliaBUGS.@bugs("""
model {
    for( i in 1 : N ) {
        b[i] ~ dnorm(mu,tau)
        r[i] ~ dbin(p[i],n[i])
        p[i] <- logistic(b[i])
    }
    pop.mean <- exp(mu) / (1 + exp(mu))
    mu ~ dnorm(0.0,1.0E-6)
    sigma <- 1 / sqrt(tau)
    tau ~ dgamma(0.001,0.001)
}
""", false)

build_model(data) = JuliaBUGS.compile(model_def, data)
